content: Ellipsis Ellipsis is the omission from a clause of one or more words that are nevertheless understood in the context of the remaining elements. In machine translation, elliptical constructions in the source language pose a problem in two situations. First, if the target language does not allow the same types of ellipsis, requiring the elided material to be predicted from context. Second, if the elided material affects the syntax of the sentence. For example, in Russian the grammatical function of a noun phrase, and thus its inflection, may depend on the elided verb, or, conversely, the verb inflection may depend on the elided subject.
